oracle_policy: Every assertion maps to a fixed field in the immutable candidate-independent oracle and a numbered outcome in the pinned decision packet; candidate output is never a source of expected values.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Query a newly owned cold graph and ensure no warm defaults, role, revision, review item, or no-risk inference appears.
cases.setup: Create a unique empty actual-FalkorDB graph and query before seeding.
cases.failure_detected: Warm data or a default role invents current ownership, evidence, or absence-of-risk from an empty graph.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Call the existing dock_at=20:29Z path without known_at and compare its historical-effective/current-knowledge result to the accepted board oracle.
cases.setup: Seed the pinned synthetic dock fixture and invoke only the pre-existing single-axis call shape.
cases.failure_detected: Adding a knowledge-time mode silently changes the existing caller's role, source history, candidate order, or unknown-link semantics.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Hold effective time at 20:29Z and set knowledge to 20:17:59Z, one second before R2 observation.
cases.setup: Query actual FalkorDB with explicit effective_at and known_at; inspect the complete operations-visible response, not a UI-filtered subset.
cases.failure_detected: The axes are collapsed, the observation boundary is early, or later-known R2 content/existence leaks into the response.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Keep effective_at=20:29Z and advance known_at to 20:19Z so R2 is known but not effective.
cases.setup: Query the same graph and same valid time with the later knowledge cutoff; require source-observation filtering and explicit review edges.
cases.failure_detected: R2 is hidden after it is known, applied early before its effective time, missing provenance/status, or its exact review queue is guessed or misclassified.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Hold known_at at 20:19Z and move effective_at to the exact 20:30Z R2 boundary.
cases.setup: Query graph ownership using effective interval at 20:30Z while source visibility remains bounded by the 20:19Z observation cutoff.
cases.failure_detected: The query uses knowledge time to select valid ownership or presents a known future-effective role as already effective at knowledge time.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Request future effective time 20:30Z using only knowledge available at 20:17:59Z.
cases.setup: Evaluate the crossed-axis pair on the same seeded graph and inspect all returned IDs, titles, counts, wording, paths, and unknown-state labels.
cases.failure_detected: Hindsight exposes R2 or guesses duty/swing even though R1 has expired and R2 was not yet known.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Remove each required test-owned relationship independently, then reseed and compare the baseline.
cases.setup: On a unique owned graph remove only R2-SUPERSEDES-R1, query; restore; remove only R2's OWNED_BY assignment, query; reseed and compare exact fixed values.
cases.failure_detected: Static or lexical fallback ignores explicit edge removal, a mutation has collateral effect, missing linkage is called current, or reseed drifts.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Inject the exact existing restricted dock fixture and compare complete operations-visible responses at all pinned axis pairs before and after.
cases.setup: Use the denied-source fixture tripwires from the frozen shift-board oracle; do not treat hidden fixture details as expected output.
cases.failure_detected: Restricted information leaks directly, through an existence/count side channel, a relationship/path, or a dependent paraphrase under any axis pair.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Normalize nonzero UTC offsets independently on both axes, then submit malformed and timezone-naive inputs on either axis.
cases.setup: Compare +02:00 values with canonical UTC output; snapshot graph/output before each invalid submission and require rejection before mutation.
cases.failure_detected: Offset semantics differ across axes, malformed timestamps mutate state, or timezone-naive input silently uses a local-time fallback.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Cold-start, seed twice, reconnect through a fresh client/restarted app, and inspect all side-effect counters.
cases.setup: Use one unique owned graph/process; compare exact result after reseed/reconnect with the pinned known-R2 outcome; inspect graph/action/external-write counts and cleanup ownership.
cases.failure_detected: Duplicate fixture data, warm-client-only behavior, implicit writes, external actions, cross-lane cleanup, or browser/API disagreement.
